title: Hanasato Minori — Happy Birthday! 2024〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: The day before Minori's birthday
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We're a day early but, here goes!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Minori!
Minori! Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe, thanks Miku! Thanks everyone!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh Minori, isn't this just wonderful?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ahhh... An idol's birthday really is special. Today's the day you feel like thanking the world for everything it has to offer.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know what you mean! The feeling of joy just wells up within you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It truly does.
Hey, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What is it?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm so happy to have met you. I couldn't be more grateful for you being born into this world.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wha?! Aaaaaahhh!!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sorry, Minori. What did you say?

rows.Speaker: Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Haha!
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, since we've got a special livestream tomorrow, we should probably head back soon.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Good luck with the stream. We believe in you♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Um... Miku, everyone...
I know I've said this before, but...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you so much for supporting me, and looking out for me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've felt crushed and completely lost more times than I can count...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But every time I come here, you guys cheer me on and give me advice and strength!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If it weren't for you guys, I don't think I would have come this far.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So I really, really can't thank you enough!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm happy you feel that way. I mean, there isn't actually an awful lot we can do for you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We can practice together and hear out your troubles, but that's about it...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And that's more than enough! That in itself has helped me so much!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Plus, it's ultimately up to me to put the effort in!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe, I knew you'd say that. Believe it or not, there are fewer people who know that and still make the effort than you might imagine.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're really shaping up to be a fine idol, Minori♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Everyone! I may be inexperienced, but I hope you continue to support me!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe, gladly♪
We'll always be looking out for you.
song00004_off_f
Minori's birthday
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, it's time!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Minori Hanasato's Special Birthday Livestream♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Happy birthday Minori!>
<Have a great birthday, Minori!>
<I've been looking forward to this!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you for your birthday wishes, everyone! I've also been looking forward to the livestream!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh? Says the one who was endlessly pacing back and forth to calm her nerves just seconds ago!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Hey! Airi, keep that hush, hush!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<That's Minori for you.>
<You got this, Minori!>
<D'aww, Minori!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
E-Er...
Allow me to do that introduction again!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you everyone for joining my special birthday livestream! It's all thanks to your support that I'm able to celebrate my birthday like this today!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Although I'm far from experienced and still have a long way to go...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Someday, I'll be an amazing idol who feels worthy of standing on the same stage as Haruka and the others, so please, continue to support me!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<You sound like the real deal, Minori>
<Show us what you're made of!>
<I know you got this, Minori!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay! You've got the energy, now show them that you're more than just talk!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And with that, it's time for the Special Birthday Challenge Segment!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Special Birthday Challenge?>
<What's she gonna do?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll be putting all of my skills to the test with a special challenge!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The challenge is...a dance cover!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, Minori is very good at copying dance routines.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I've had many opportunities to practice thanks to our livestreams, but this one's going to be tougher than anything I've ever done before!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The routine is only for the chorus, and I'll only be able to view the dance once. If I can perform the dance with less than three mistakes, I win!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<What? Ur only watching the vid once?!>
<“Only for the chorus?” Wdym only?!>
<Oooh, this'll be interesting.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
And now, it's time to reveal the song for Minori's challenge to our viewers.
Here, it's on-screen now!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I know it but I can't remember the dance.>
<Whoa, srsly! Isn't this one insanely tough?>
<Even the OG dancers couldn't keep up.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: First, we'll give Minori a chance to watch the original dance video, and if she thinks she's got it, then we're good to go!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But we don't want to put too much pressure on her, so please allow her to change the song if needed, okay?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Your wish is our command, Shizuku!>
<Go Minori!>
<Just peeked at the video. You sure about this?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori, the video is ready for you now. I'm gonna hit play now, okay?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ah, they're the popular idol group that recently debuted! Wow, their moves are so on point!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's because everyone in this group was scouted for their impeccable dance skills. They may be new faces in the idol scene, but they're head and shoulders above the rest.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. This choreography is far from beginner level. Remembering even just the chorus in one viewing doesn't sound easy.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (She's right... I can't remember all these fine details down to their fingertips, but I can keep up with their general movements.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Oh, it's the chorus!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Left foot lean then spin...just as I thought.
And then? Oh! It's that difficult part from the intro!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
One, two, three, one, two, three...
Bam-buh-dum-dum...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, I've got it!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<What! Really?!>
<So once was actually enough?>
<You're amazing, Minori!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You got this, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Breathe in...and out.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm ready to start the Special Birthday Challenge!
